en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3262 - Al-Sakuni narrated through his chain of transmission that Commander of the Faithful (as) said

regarding a man who ordered his slave to kill another man, and the slave carried out the order:
(Imam (as) said) "Is not the slave like his master's whip or sword?"
Therefore, the master was executed, and the slave was imprisoned.
